//: What an international school teacher earns, by country. Used only when neither the school nor its adverts publish a figure.
//why: Per-school salary is not public data. A sweep of job packs, school sites and salary aggregators found figures for 9 of 521 schools. Country averages are the honest alternative: they tell you what to expect in a place, and they say so rather than pretending to be about one school.
//limits: A country average is identical for every school in that country, so it CANNOT rank schools against each other. Within-country ranking stays on package terms and accreditation. See README.
//source: internationalteachersalary.com — anonymous self-reported submissions from teachers. Not audited. `reports` is how many teachers stand behind each figure.
//minReports: Figures backed by fewer than 5 reports are kept for reference but not shown: one teacher's contract is not a country average. Bangladesh sat at $88K on a single report.
//currency: USD per year, gross base salary, excluding housing, flights and dependant places. The Package columns carry those.

countries.//thin: Below the threshold. Kept so the gap is visible and so a later run can top them up, but not shown in the sheet.
countries.//missing: No data at source: Sri Lanka, Nepal, Bhutan, Kyrgyzstan, Costa Rica, Nicaragua, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea, Mozambique, Maldives and the smaller islands.
